_comment: Campaign keys a campaign may leave EMPTY, read by the tests of BOTH
languages — the same referee as campaign-env.json, for the same reason:
noyau/messages.ts and api/config.go each hold their own copy, and a copy
Not filling a field must not block a campaign. Four of the nine are the
campaign's own contact details, and a small team has the right to give a
telephone number to nobody, to run without a website, to publish no
contact address, and to send its letters without naming the town they
leave from — the four live only in the sign-off line, whose empty parts
the engine already drops. The other five are what makes a message
CORRECT — the candidate, what is said about them, and who signs — and a
message missing one of those is a message that should not leave.
EMPTY is what this list allows, and nothing else. A key still carrying the
shipped template's value blocks whether it is in this list or not:
"06 00 00 00 00" reaches five hundred mayors verbatim, which is the exact
failure the gate exists for and has nothing to do with declining to give
